en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a street scene with people walking and horse-drawn wagons. The central focus is on a large church with a distinct baroque-style dome and tower. To the right are grand, ornate buildings with statues on the roofline. The street is lined with trees and appears to be a quiet, possibly small-town area. The text at the top is in German and reads: 'Lobositz a. d. Elbe Kirche zu St. Wenzel.'
